item.title: Remembering Robert Duvall
item.description: Miami, FL - February 16, 2026 - Robert Duvall, the Oscar-winning actor best known for his indelible performances in The Godfather, Apocalypse Now and Tender Mercies, has died at 95. Born in San Diego and trained under famed acting coach Sanford Meisner, Duvall built a résumé that stretched from stage to screen, earning seven Academy Award nominations and winning Best Actor for his portrayal of a broken country singer in Tender Mercies. item.description: Miami, FL - February 17, 2026 - It is with profound sorrow that we announce the tragic and sudden death of Sean Christopher Posner, a truly legendary member of the Miami community, whose impact on those who knew him bordered on the mythical. Sean died on January 30th, at the age of 51, from an asthma-induced respiratory arrest leading to cardiac arrest.
